freePlan.limits: 150 fast tokens/day, generations carry a watermark, non-commercial use only.

keyLimits.en: 150 fast tokens/day, watermarked output, non-commercial use only.
25,000 fast tokens/month, adds relaxed (queued) generation on selected models.
60,000 fast tokens/month, extends relaxed access to selected image and video models.

cautions.en: Leonardo AI's own documentation (pricing-and-plans FAQ) describes the product as moving to a Pay-As-You-Go model with no monthly fees, which conflicts with the tiered Essential/Premium/Ultimate subscription pricing reported by third-party trackers; the plan names and figures here could not be confirmed on the official pricing page directly (403 blocked) and should be re-verified.
Older plan names (Apprentice, Artisan, Maestro) have reportedly been renamed to Essential, Premium, Ultimate; some still-live third-party content uses the old names interchangeably.

capabilities.en: AI image generation using proprietary Leonardo models and third-party models (e.g. Flux), with fine-tuned styles.
Image editing, upscaling and photo-to-painting style transformation tools.
Credit/token-based generation system shared across image (and on higher plans, video) models.

limitations.en: Free tier output carries a watermark and is restricted to non-commercial use.
Usage is metered by a token/credit system, so heavy generation workloads can exhaust a plan's monthly allotment before the billing cycle ends.

reason.en: Leading commercial AI image generator frequently compared to Leonardo AI on quality and pricing.
Adobe's AI image generator, a direct competitor with tighter Creative Cloud integration.
Another AI image generation and editing platform targeting a similar creative audience.
Flux models compete directly with Leonardo's own image models and are also usable inside Leonardo itself.

unknowns: Official leonardo.ai pricing page and docs.leonardo.ai were blocked (HTTP 403) to automated fetch in this session; the plan names (Essential/Premium/Ultimate vs. Apprentice/Artisan/Maestro) and exact prices come from third-party trackers and a search snippet, not a directly read official page.
Whether Leonardo AI has fully transitioned to Pay-As-You-Go pricing (as its own FAQ doc states) or still runs tiered monthly subscriptions (as trackers report) is unresolved.
Team plan pricing (Starter/Growth) mentioned by trackers was not verified.
conflicts: Official docs.leonardo.ai/docs/pricing-and-plans-faq describes a Pay-As-You-Go, no-monthly-fee model, while multiple independent pricing trackers describe fixed monthly subscription tiers (Essential $12, Premium $30, Ultimate $60); could not reconcile within this session's budget.
